School Fellowship Policy

Introduction:

The School Fellowship Policy outlines the guidelines and regulations governing the administration, selection
process, rights, and responsibilities of fellows within our educational institution.

Purpose:

The purpose of the School Fellowship Program is to provide opportunities for exceptional individuals to
contribute to the academic community, engage in research, and foster intellectual growth and innovation within
our school.
